name: Cyrus II Chess
summary: "Cyrus II" is a versatile chess program suitable for players of all skill levels. It offers rapid moves for beginners and challenging tournament-level play for experts. Features include move takebacks, replaying finished games, and setting up custom positions for problem-solving. The program is intuitive, allowing players to explore its options through experimentation. No matter which keys are pressed, Cyrus will always attempt to interpret the input and respond accordingly.
